title: GIG-3189: Ignore Invalid Postmaclone Rules On Up And Down
description: Loads docker, setup, and custom commands even when the postmaclone section fails validation, and updates 1Password secrets by piping item JSON so produce password rotation works in GitHub Actions.

test_plan.description: Invalid postmaclone rules do not block config load or custom commands
steps: Confirm a yml with valid docker plus core_activity_logs.context: {} loads docker and artisan, and sets postmacloneError
Confirm Application registers the artisan command and does not record a config load error

test_plan.description: Password rotation writes 1Password via item JSON, not field assignment
steps: Confirm applyFieldValue replaces password by id or label and appends a CONCEALED field when missing
Confirm git log on the PR uses a fix: or feat: subject so semantic-release will cut a version after merge
